# Patchland: Claim It All

> Patchland is an offline territory game with paper patches, coming soon to iOS and Android. Trace, place and spread to win land from quirky AI lords.

Patchland is an offline territory game by ipe() (https://ipe.rest/) for iOS and Android. It has NOT been released: no store page, price or release date exists yet. The game app and this website collect no personal information, use no analytics or ads and set no cookies.

## Pages

- [Home](https://patchland.ipe.rest/)
- [Release notes](https://patchland.ipe.rest/releases/): what is in each TestFlight build, in plain words
- [Support](https://patchland.ipe.rest/support/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://patchland.ipe.rest/privacy/)
- [Terms of Use](https://patchland.ipe.rest/terms/)

## Languages

English (original) and Korean (original); ja, zh, es, pt, id, ru, vi, fr, de are AI translations under /<code>/.
